title: checklist: console-sign-out-and-ended-session acceptance[0] kept-key list misses the anonymous shell's own `flow-palette-recents` = "[]"
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzj9DrVWXkq7joYHGB

Kind: assertion defect (test-fix card; the product is right)

Item: identity-auth.console-sign-out-and-ended-session rev 2, acceptance[0].verify: "after sign-out both stores hold only keys from the kept set: auth-session-token, auth-session-user-id, vite-ui-theme, objectui-locale and objectui-locale-seed".

Measured at main a557fa386bc3 (console built from this tree), stock showcase, twice on fresh contexts: after Account menu → Log out, the login page's localStorage holds `auth-session-user-id`, `objectui-locale-seed` and `flow-palette-recents` = `"[]"`; sessionStorage is empty; `qa-probe-E`, every `objectui:metadata:*`, every `:u:‹id›` key, `objectui-offline-queue`, `os:*` keys are gone. A fresh, never-signed-in browser opening `/_console/login` holds the same `flow-palette-recents` = `"[]"` and nothing else.

Why the product is right: `purgeSignedOutUserClientState` (ui/packages/auth/src/ActiveOrganizationStorage.ts:296-311) sweeps everything outside SIGNED_OUT_KEPT_KEYS; the key reappears afterwards because `FlowPaletteRecentsProvider` (ui/packages/app-shell/src/context/FlowPaletteRecentsProvider.tsx:165-181) re-hydrates with `userId = null` and `saveLocal([], null)` writes the unscoped base key. It carries nothing of the signed-out user (always `[]` with no user) — negative[1]'s "key the signed-out user's session wrote" is not met.

Needed test-fix: acceptance[0].verify should judge "keys the signed-out user's session wrote" (as negative[1] does) and name anonymous-shell state that a never-signed-in visit also writes (today `flow-palette-recents` = `"[]"`) as expected, or tell the runner to diff against a fresh anonymous visit of /_console/login. (Product-side alternative, if preferred: have FlowPaletteRecentsProvider skip `saveLocal` when `userId` is null; then the clause holds as written.)

Duplicates searched: "flow-palette-recents sign-out" → 0; "sign-out purge kept keys" → 2, both [PM seat] cards, unrelated.
